proof:
by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hp⟩ := hX
  filter_upwards [hτ.tendsto_top] with ω hω
  intro x
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ :=
    (hω.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (WithTop.coe_lt_top x))).exists
  have hN' : (x : WithTop ι) < τ N ω := hN
  have hS_open : IsOpen {y : ι | (y : WithTop ι) < τ N ω} :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage WithTop.continuous_coe
  have hS_mem : {y : ι | (y : WithTop ι) < τ N ω} ∈ 𝓝[Set.Ici x] x :=
    mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (hS_open.mem_nhds hN')
  refine ContinuousWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hp N ω x) ?_
    (stoppedProcess_eq_of_le hN'.le).symm
  filter_upwards [hS_mem] with y hy
  exact (stoppedProcess_eq_of_le hy.le).symm
